meta.title: Meet The New Fed Chair Wall Street Is Still Trying To Read
meta.hook: The Federal Reserve has a new chair, and this Friday he gives his first major speech since taking the job.
meta.description: Kevin Warsh was confirmed by the Senate in May 2026 in the closest vote for a Fed chair in the institution's history, and sworn in on May 22, 2026. He's not new to the Fed: in 2006 he became its youngest-ever governor at 35, sat beside Ben Bernanke through the 2008 financial crisis, then resigned in 2011 over policy disagreements. His first Jackson Hole keynote as chair lands August 28, 2026. Educational content only, not financial advice.
